messages:
Alex Chow: Quick sync — region expansion status for ap-southeast-1 and eu-south-1. Need to confirm routing ownership, DB replica deps, and KMS/access for residency. Can folks paste any open blockers?
Priya Patel: Milestones: 1) infra provisioning (done for ap-southeast-1), 2) routing policy + failover tests, 3) DB replica & backup validation, 4) compliance signoff. We’re on track but DB replica lag test failing in eu-south-1.
Tom Nguyen: DB replica lag: seeing ~45s at peak write bursts. Root cause looks like WAL shipping queue on replica host. I have a tuned rsync window but need ops time to test.
Emily Ross: @Tom can you drop the PR for the replica config tweak? I’ll do a quick review and run integration tests in staging.
Tom Nguyen: PR up: https://git.internal/rw/infra/merge/4823 — changes to pg_wal_receiver params + bump instance class for replica. Logs in the PR.
Alex Chow: :eyes: tagging @Irfan for KMS/residency implications — will new replicas need separate CMKs per region?
Irfan Khan: Yes — per compliance we provision region-specific CMKs. For eu-south-1 we have key alias created but IAM bindings still pending. I’ll add Terraform snippet to the PR.
Priya Patel: Ownership: infra team (Tom) for replicas, net infra (Irfan) for KMS and VPC endpoints, eng-platform (Alex/Emily) for routing policies & smoke tests. Can each owner add ETA?
Tom Nguyen: ETA for replica fix and canary tests: 24h if ops window approved.
Irfan Khan: IAM bindings + terraform change: EOD today. Need access approval from security (request in Okta pending).
Emily Ross: Routing policy changes prepared in repo: https://git.internal/rw/platform-routing/pulls/129 — contains new weights and residency rules. I need someone from infra to validate the healthcheck URLs before I merge.
Alex Chow: @Tom can you run healthcheck target validation in staging (curl -I) and paste results? We want 200 within 500ms for the canary.
Tom Nguyen: Quick check from staging: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://staging-ap-southeast-1.rw-inference.internal/health` -> `200 0.312`
Emily Ross: Nice. I’ll queue canary rollout for ap-southeast-1 tomorrow morning PST and watch latency.
DeployBot: Deploy queued by Emily Ross for canary route update — runbook: /runbooks/region-cutover. Status: scheduled.
Priya Patel: Risk register note — DB replica lag could impact regional reads fallback. Mitigation: fallback to primary for reads for 30s windows and alert via SLO. Add to runbook please.
Alex Chow: Agree. @SRE Oncall can you add an alert to monitor replica_lag > 10s for eu-south-1 and page at 60s?
SRE Oncall: Will do. Alert policy created: `ReplicaLag-eu-south-1` -> page at 60s, ticket at 30s.
Emily Ross: One ask for reviewers: please validate that the new routing rule respects `data_residency: strict` header — sample policy is in the PR description.
Irfan Khan: Confirmed KMS keys scope won't break strict residency; will run the key rotation simulation tomorrow.
Tom Nguyen: Ops window request submitted for tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. If approved, I’ll push replica config and run canary.
Alex Chow: Thanks all. Action items recap in thread: 1) Tom — replica PR & canary (ETA 24h), 2) Irfan — KMS IAM bindings (EOD), 3) Emily — routing canary (tomorrow AM), 4) SRE Oncall — alerts created. Ping here when PRs merged.
Priya Patel: I’ll update the project board and notify compliance once keys are confirmed.
Emily Ross: leaving a final note: schedule a short async postmortem checklist if any of the canary checks fail. +1 on runbook updates.
Alex Chow: Great. Closing the loop — please drop a quick thumbs-up when you’ve completed your task. :thumbsup:
